title: Durable local model installation and recovery
description: Durable local model installation and recovery for the approved ARA-022 plan.
acceptance_criteria: Given duplicate request/delivery UUIDs, when model operations replay or race, then one durable owner remains and conflicting reuse is rejected.
Given restart, partial rollback or lost lease, when recovery runs, then authoritative inventory/checkpoints and acknowledged unresolved current/previous runtime attempts govern fenced writes.
Given paused intent and verification admission racing, when either wins its database lock, then no incompatible maintenance/inference is admitted before settlement.
Given a newer installation owner, when a failed historical operation is retried, then current installation state is preserved and superseded retry is rejected.
Given deletion with no live use, when it completes, then runtime absence is confirmed and defaults/history remain.
test_cases: Contracts/runtime/SQL/API observed reds then greens; migration0005, dispatcher, heartbeat and readiness checks.
Independent reviewer reproduced three SQL failures; six regression cases went red then green, and unchanged reviewer harness passed three tests.
Further two-current/abandoned-operation settlement regressions went red then green; combined SQL/state/API batch passed 29.
Worker reload burst/stopping-tree real-process regression; final integrated rerun passed.
verification: Lead final real-service backend 185 passed in 38.77 seconds. Targeted model SQL 38 passed; independent original/restart/claim-race probes passed. All unresolved UUIDs survive crash and ordinary failure; unconfirmed settlement blocks competing inference/mutations and cleanup does not replay or double-count attempts. Superseded retry, verification pause, deadline/stall, exhausted/malformed transfer, queued pause and multiple cleanup cases covered. Debounced worker native and forced-polling tests passed; actual six-write Docker burst caused one restart per worker.
